test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper( Held On: 16 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following countries does **NOT** share land boundaries with India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sri Lanka**__.

__
 
• **India shares borders with 7 sovereign countrie**s

 
 
• India shares **land borders with ****China, Bhutan, Nepal, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Afghanistan, and Myanmar**. 
 
• **Bangladesh and Pakistan** share both **land borders as well as maritime borders.**
 
• **While Sri Lanka shares only a maritime border.**__
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f58d8fa1f14d27d10d46a922a1b35e622698966c085003890dc15907f13655e1.png] 

 
• ** India has 15,106.7 Km of land border and a coastline of 7,516.6 Km including island territories**.
 
• The length of our land borders with neighbouring countries is as under: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/43099f10f4eed0a3d8e45765856ca45aed3421de162b4732fc86c8ccb8ec167c.png] 

 
• **Across the sea to the south, lie our island neighbours(i.e. separated by water)—Sri Lanka and the Maldive**s.
 
• **Sri Lanka is separated from India by the Palk Strait**.
